summary.text: Bob Carter is a Democratic state representative from Montana House District 96 who has served in the Montana House since 2023 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
His career experience includes work as a scientist and reserve police officer.

paragraphs.text: Bob Carter was born in Great Falls, Montana, and earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Montana in 2021.
Ballotpedia lists his career experience as working as a scientist and reserve police officer, and lists the Target Range School District as a prior office.

Carter has served in the Montana House since 2023, and in the 2025-2026 session he was vice chair of the Agriculture Committee and a member of the Energy, Technology, and Federal Relations and Business and Labor committees.
He advanced from the June 2, 2026 Democratic primary for District 96.
